findings.before: Wrapper TERM/INT could leave its start_new_session child process group running; timeout cleanup could wait 2+2 seconds.
findings.change: ChildGuard installs TERM/INT handlers, registers only the owned child process group under a blocked-signal spawn window, forwards TERM then waits at most0.75 seconds and sends KILL with at most0.15 seconds reap. Child inherits the restored original signal mask. Separate INTERRUPTION.json is fsynced before unwind, retaining actual signal/group/cleanup. No unrelated owner process enumeration or kill is used.

findings.before: Combined and same-grid number/energy denominators were finite but not required positive, permitting negative relative residuals to compare below positive gates.
findings.change: Strict finite positive number and energy validated for old/reference/combined/same-grid inventories and reconstructed/reference denominators. Signed stress remains allowed. Reported and computed ledger/kernel/reference residuals must be finite nonnegative before gate comparison. Existing numeric tolerances unchanged.
